Monthly

August 1, 2025
Download report
The US Leveraged Loan Index Monthly Wrap
captures the dynamics of the primary and
secondary leveraged loan markets. Commentary
and data include detailed analysis of
Morningstar LSTA US Leveraged Loan Index
returns and pricing trends. Institutional loan
issuance, maturity wall breakdowns, market
supply/demand dynamics, market flex data,
returns by asset class and outperforming and
underperforming credits are among the topics
discussed.
